name: Stawamus Chief
region: Stawamus Chief Provincial Park, British Columbia
why: Hundreds of wooden steps, then ladders and chains up the back of a 700 m granite monolith to summits over Howe Sound and the town of Squamish.
book: No pass needed in most years; parking at the Chief campground and day-use lot fills on summer weekends.
water: None above the creek near the start: carry 2 litres.
dangers: Steep, exposed granite with chains and ladders near the peaks.
Unfenced cliff edges: people have fallen to their deaths.

points.name: Stawamus Chief day-use area
